challenges.title: The Locked Lab Drawer
challenges.description: A drawer is sealed with a 4-digit code. The clues are hidden on the periodic table posters.
instructions: Find the 4 posters on the back wall.
Each poster has one element highlighted in red.
Convert the atomic numbers of those elements into digits, in poster order.
Enter the 4-digit code on the drawer lock.
hints: Poster order is left to right.

challenges.title: Caesar's Message
challenges.description: An envelope contains a message encrypted with a Caesar cipher. Decode it to get the password for the next envelope.
instructions: Use the cipher wheel printout to decode the message.
Shift each letter back by 3 positions.
The decoded word is the password for the next envelope.
hints: A shifts back to X, B to Y, C to Z.
